prayerExcerpt.en-US: Glory be to God for all things.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Glória a Deus por todas as coisas.

meta.face: A lean ascetic man around 40, younger than the other bishops, a high bare forehead with thinning dark hair, gently hollow cheeks, a short thin pointed dark beard, earnest eloquent expression.
meta.basis: Young with little beard (Painter's Manual); high forehead and hollow cheeks in the Byzantine icon type.

sources.title: Dionysius of Fourna, The Painter's Manual (Hermeneia), c. 1730 — Didron's 1845 French edition
Byzantine icon of Chrysostom (Met), Christian Iconography

history.note: Face edited to break the stock look-alike face shared by most male cards
